dataset_description: scikit-learn Digits (1,797 source images at 8x8, normalized and bilinearly resized to 28x28)
notes: Gamma multiplicative noise is a simplified speckle-inspired perturbation, not a physical SAR simulator.
The same held-out noisy inputs are reused for the MSE and L1 model comparison within each noise condition.
The evaluation subset and number of epochs are small; results are illustrative, not generalizable claims.
